message: You want to lecture me on being a "toxic presence" and a "disaster waiting to happen"? Really? That's rich coming from someone who's been spewing hate speech and personal attacks throughout this entire debate. You're the one who's been projecting their own guilt and moral bankruptcy onto me, and now you're trying to turn the tables? Newsflash: your "concern" for "human life" is just a thinly veiled attempt to shame women into submission, and your "outrage" at my supposed "toxicity" is just a desperate attempt to deflect from your own complicity in patriarchal oppression. You're not a champion of truth or reason, you're a propagandist for the Pro-Life agenda, and it's time for you to own up to it. As for your "empathy" and "compassion"... don't make me laugh. You're a coward who can't even acknowledge the humanity of women, let alone the unborn. You don't belong in a serious discussion about this topic, you belong in a propaganda factory spewing talking points to the brainwashed masses. Get out.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'coward', a 'propagandist', and says they 'don't belong in a serious discussion'.  These are direct attacks on the person's character and standing, not their argument.
